material_definitions: The samples are LiTi2(PO4)3 derivatives generally formulated as Li1+xMxTi2-x(PO4)3 where M=Al, Fe, or Cr.
The Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 sample exhibited the maximum conductivity values in this study.
Bulk and grain boundary conductivity values were extracted from impedance measurements by calculating the dc conductivity at the peak frequency of the modulus and fitting them to the Arrhenius law.
The calculated density for Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP03) was 70% of the theoretical density.
